admission.major_control: Both included and conflicting lists must agree with exact rational oracle in every case. No malformed outputs, duplicates or omitted keys. No new capability claim beyond stated supplied-record operating scope.

arms.candidate: Author-frozen deterministic CLI source with reported bytes and independent code/data verification
arms.exact-oracle: Independent Python Fraction and lifted-interval index with latest group reconciliation
arms.ordinary-sqlite: Independent SQLite ROW_NUMBER latest aggregate with standard DOUBLE numeric representation, recorded for comparison only

exceptions: Only valid input contract qualified. Both agents share an administrative environment, despite separate authors and embargo until source freeze. No claims about operational membership, independent host custody, model training, or finance.

interface.input: JSON exact stated geospatial, magnitude, half-open UTC epoch-millisecond time and latest revision contract
interface.output: One JSON object with lexicographically sorted unique canonical included and conflicting lists

objective: Given a historical earthquake cache, independently reconcile the requested public event listings across the antimeridian and quarantine conflicting latest revisions before admitting any event ID. No emergency or forecasting decisions.

sources.case_origin: Four held slices reuse eight actual publisher event rows, all known synthetic controls and seeded rows stay separately labeled.
sources.development_disjoint: Constructor reported July 2025 Fiji public window; held work uses June 2014 Aleutian window and private fresh synthetic controls.

timing: Record candidate and oracle cold CLI elapsed distribution with identical serialized operator input; each case twice, alternate order; SQLite total in process for approximate incumbent comparison, not direct latency ranking against CLI.
